item.title: Fernando Mendoza receives hero’s welcome at St. Elmo Steak House
item.description: IU quarterback Fernando Mendoza was greeted with a standing ovation at St. Elmo Steak House in Indianapolis, where he is attending the NFL Combine, after leading the Hoosiers to their first ever football national championship and winning the Heisman Trophy.

item.title: Indiana lawmakers wrap up 2026 legislative session
item.description: Indiana lawmakers passed legislation to create a northwest Indiana stadium authority, expand eligibility for Indiana's employer-sponsored child care tax credit program, and crack down on commercial drivers without proper immigration documentation.

item.title: Death toll in a strike on girls’ school in southern Iran rises to 40, state media say
item.description: The U.S. and Israel launched a major attack on targets across Iran, resulting in the death of at least 40 people and wounding 45 others, while Iran responded with a missile attack on Israel, Bahrain, Kuwait, and other countries in the region.

item.title: 6-planet parade will grace the night sky on Saturday
item.description: On Saturday, sky-gazers will be able to see six planets in the sky, with Mercury, Venus, Saturn, and Jupiter visible to the naked eye, and Uranus and Neptune visible with binoculars or a telescope.

item.title: Family claims abuse in Henry County jail led to son’s death; sheriff denies
item.description: Nicholas Gulley, who had been arrested for trespassing and jailed in Henry County, Indiana, was airlifted to an Indianapolis hospital after, his mother claims, sheriff's deputies used excessive force in an altercation with him. The sheriff's denies the mother's claims. I-Team 8's Tim Spears reports.

item.title: Indiana lawmakers react to U.S. led attack on Iran
item.description: The US and Israel's attack on Iran has sparked debate among Indiana's congressional delegation, with some supporting the military action and others expressing concern for the safety of US troops and civilians.

item.title: US and Israel attack Iran as Tehran retaliates across Middle East
item.description: The US and Israel launched strikes on Iran, targeting its supreme leader, president and head of the armed forces, prompting Iran to retaliate with strikes towards Israel and US targets across the Middle East.

item.title: Cold with light snow before a warmup next week | Feb. 28, 2026
item.description: The 7-day forecast for Indianapolis calls for a warmer and wetter week, with rain chances staying elevated through Thursday and Friday, potentially leading to ponding and river rises.

item.title: Pedestrian dies after colliding with an IndyGo bus on North Post Road
item.description: A female pedestrian died after colliding with an IndyGo bus on North Post Road, and Indianapolis Metropolitan Police Department is investigating the crash.

item.title: Iranian state media say country’s supreme leader is dead
item.description: Israel launched a daylight attack on Iran's capital, with the US participating, in an attempt to pressure Iran into a deal over its nuclear program.
